title: Divisible by 6: every pair is reachable
notes: A tracks the remainder mod 3 of a binary number and B whether it is even. A number divisible by 6 is both. Every one of the 3 × 2 = 6 pairs is reachable, one for each remainder mod 6: the worst case for the product's size.
